name: The All-In Podcast
zh_summary: Jason Calacanis 指出 AI 最大機會：工作場所採用仍處於早期。Gallup 調查顯示工作中頻繁與每日使用 AI 仍為 10-20%。頂級企業因網路安全恐懼不允許無約束使用或連接電子郵件/知識庫。一旦網路威脅緩解，每日用戶可能從 10% 升至 60-80%。Uber 為每位員工購買 ChatGPT 為例。
en_summary: Jason Calacanis Identifies AI’s Biggest Opportunity: Adoption Is Still Nascent At Work. Gallup survey shows frequent vs daily AI use at work still 10-20%. Top enterprises not allowing unconstrained use or connecting email/knowledge bases due to cyber fears. Once cyber mitigated, daily users could go from 10% to 60-80%. Uber bought ChatGPT for every employee as example.
text:
Jason Calacanis Identifies AI’s Biggest Opportunity: Adoption Is Still Nascent At Work

“Gallup's been keeping a survey of who's using AI at work.

The people using it frequently versus daily, we're still talking about 10 and 20% here. It's nascent.

A lot of the top enterprises are not letting their employees use this in an unconstrained fashion, and they're certainly not letting them connect their email, their knowledge bases, their Notions, their Slacks.

Big corporations are not letting people actually use the power of AI because they're scared about cyber.

So once the cyber threat gets mitigated, this is gonna go from 10% of people being daily users to 60, 70, 80%.

There's so much growth left here when every single employee has an agent. I saw just last week Uber bought ChatGPT for every employee.

That's going to be the next shoe to drop, do you buy these things for every single employee?”

en_summary: Macroharder and Minihard both have 220k GB300s with 800 gig nics configured for training. Gun Range will have the same. Spam will have ~200k GB300s configured for inference. Good progress by the SpaceX team. Gun Range tracking to be operational by end of November and Spam in December.
text:
Macroharder and Minihard both have 220k GB300s with 800 gig nics configured for training. Gun Range will have the same. Spam (used to house Hormel products) will have ~200k GB300s, but configured for inference, so much simpler networking and less than half the fiber. 

I walked the whole Colossus 2 site around midnight and again this morning. 

Good progress by the SpaceX team and contractors. Gun Range is tracking to be operational by end of November and Spam in December.

en_summary: (Reposted by @elonmusk) The scale of Starlink is almost impossible to comprehend. Out of 16,848 active satellites in orbit as of October 31, 2026, 11,184 are Starlink (66%). Starlink alone has nearly 2 times more than every other operator combined. SpaceX launched first 60 on May 24, 2019, and continues launching batches of 27, including on October 31. text:
The scale of Starlink is almost impossible to comprehend

Out of 16,848 active satellites in orbit as of October 31, 2026, 11,184 are Starlink

That's 66% of every active satellite humanity has in orbit

Just look at the numbers:

• Starlink: 11,184
• OneWeb: 651
• Amazon Kuiper: 391
• Qianfan (China): 257
• Iridium: 80

Starlink alone has nearly 2 TIMES more active satellites than every other operator on Earth COMBINED

And what's even more insane is how fast SpaceX built this

On May 24, 2019, Falcon 9 launched the first batch of 60 Starlink satellites

Just 2,717 days later, SpaceX is still launching batches of 27 satellites, including another mission on October 31

SpaceX has built the largest satellite constellation in human history, at a scale no other operator comes close to matching

And this is just the beginning
